theme.description: Light finance dashboard with clean white surfaces, structural grayscale, and Razorpay red accents for high-priority actions and kinetic elements.

headings.usage: Use Manrope for all headings (H1-H6) to provide a structured, clean, and professional aesthetic. Do not use generic sans for headings.

body.usage: Highly legible standard font for general UI text, descriptions, and standard labels.

monospace.usage: CRITICAL: Use JetBrains Mono for all financial numbers, metrics, data tables, and currency values to ensure perfect tabular alignment.

grids_and_layouts.strategy: High Density Grid (For Dashboards/Analytics). Goal: Density, Data Correlation, Scanability.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Tight (gap-4 or gap-6). Use p-4 to p-6 for card internals.
grids_and_layouts.borders_and_radius: Subtle roundness, max 8px border-radius (rounded-lg or rounded-md). Sharp edges, mostly flat UI.
grids_and_layouts.surfaces: Dashboard Cards: Flat white background (bg-white), 1px subtle border (border-slate-200), no heavy shadow by default. Hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-1), subtle shadow (shadow-md).
grids_and_layouts.navigation: Left sidebar (bg-white or bg-slate-900) for primary navigation, top header (bg-white with border-b) for context/actions.

visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: Hover states on all interactive elements. Buttons should have slight scale down on active.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid in data-heavy areas to prevent visual refraction. Use flat solid surfaces instead.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-md, sharp button with interaction animations. Primary buttons use Razorpay red.
components.cards: Cardless or dense flat rectangular styles. border border-slate-200 bg-white rounded-lg.
components.charts: Recharts. Use monochromatic tones with Razorpay red for the primary metric/forecast line to highlight insights. Ensure tooltips have solid backgrounds with borders.
components.tables: Dense. Use Shadcn Table. Hover states on rows (hover:bg-slate-50). Right-align numeric columns. Use JetBrains Mono for numbers.
components.forms: Shadcn components. Input fields with border-slate-300 focus:ring-rose-500 focus:border-rose-500.

motion.transitions: Use specific properties (transition-colors, transition-transform) not transition-all.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-in for lists and dashboard widgets (framer-motion or CSS).

accessibility.contrast: Text must meet 4.5:1 ratio. Dark slate text on white/light-grey.
accessibility.focus: Focus rings must be visible, using Razorpay red or standard blue.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.

media_and_images.usage: Use the provided avatar for the user profile in the header/sidebar. Avoid placeholders.

icons.style: Clean, consistent stroke width (1.5 or 2px). Do not use emojis for icons.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the layout with a Sidebar (left) and Main Content Area (right).
Create 3 main views: Reconciliation, Forecasting, AI CFO.
Ensure all numbers are formatted properly (e.g., currency, decimals) and use the monospace font.
Financial logic must remain deterministic in the backend.
Build a generic LLM service interface in the backend that is ready for Ollama, but return mocked/static AI recommendations for now.
Use SQLite and SQLAlchemy for data storage.
Apply the Razorpay red accent selectively—on primary CTAs, active states, and crucial forecast lines in charts, not everywhere.
Use Recharts for Cash-Flow Forecasting visualization.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is FORBIDDEN).
Never use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Do not apply 'transition: all'. Use specific transitions (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform).
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover, focus, active).
Never use AI assistant Emojis for icons.
Include data-testid on all interactive elements.
Do not use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or headers over content.
